modify_blob_rm: run the script to remove blobs with _riv, _rm, _momentum, and pred suffixes from a pickled model file
modify_blob_rm_input: run the script to load a pickled model blob file from a specified input path
modify_blob_rm_filter: run the script to filter and delete model blobs matching delimiter words like _riv, _rm, _momentum
modify_blob_rm_pred: run the script to remove all blobs whose names contain the word pred from the model dictionary
modify_blob_rm_output: run the script to save the cleaned model blobs dictionary with lr set to 0.01 to an output pickle file
